answer_1.quote: Our model consists of a Dialogue Module and a Retriever Module, enabling it to not only process multimodal inputs from the ongoing session but also ... generate conversations based on multimodal inputs, generating session memory, and linking past interactions to ensure coherence in multi-session dialogues.
answer_1.outputs: generated multimodal conversations, session memory summaries, memory linking tags

answer_2.quote: We also conduct automatic evaluations for all conversations used in the dataset quality and model performance evaluations by employing a machine evaluator ... Additionally, we quantitatively evaluate the retrieval performance of our retrieval module, assessing its ability to correctly retrieve relevant memory ... using standard retrieval metrics, including Recall@K (R@1, R@5) and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).

answer_3.quote: We also conduct comparative evaluations with other publicly available datasets ... using GPT-4o-mini and Claude-3-5-Sonnet as machine evaluators. The models are asked to judge whether the use of multimodality in the dialogues feels natural and immersive.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations to assess both the dataset quality and the model performance. For this purpose, we employ eight professional evaluators through an agency. Evaluators work in groups of three per conversation to measure inter-annotator agreement. ... Evaluators assess the conversations based on coherence and consistency, memorability, modalities alignment, and modalities engagement.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators are provided with instructions, the full transcripts of the conversations, and the associated modality elements; they score on a 5-point scale across specified criteria.
